suggest._comment: Home's Grow suggestion (lib/grow/suggest.js). A world's score: 0.5^(days since its last answer / half-life-days) × log2(1 + answers) × (1 + share wrong), plus level-fit for the world the learner's level starts from. A book offers its review once review-at questions are due, else its next lesson.
